name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 17 – Am 81
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 17a. Calls on the Commission to increase the funding for the European Instrument for Democracy and Human Rights in order to support the work of the International Criminal Court, in particular in the field of witness protection and support for victims, in light of recent US attacks threatening the survival of this international body and its victims compensation fund;
